item.title: DoorDash in talks to buy Instacart in roughly $17 billion deal
item.description: DoorDash is in advanced talks to acquire Instacart in a deal that could value the grocery-delivery platform at about $17 billion, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters on Monday.

item.title: Anthropic IPO by the numbers, from a possible valuation in the trillions to surging revenue
item.description: The artificial intelligence lab filed papers Monday setting up a Wall Street debut next month, ahead of its chief rival OpenAI and just months after SpaceX set records in June with an initial public offering that raised $86 billion.

item.title: VerSe valuation sinks; Paytm Q2 profit rises
item.description: Happy Tuesday! Dailyhunt parent VerSe Innovation’s valuation has taken a sharp hit. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

item.title: Ather rides to profit; Pronto's US AI play
item.description: Ather Energy swung to profit in the July-September quarter. This and more in today’s ETtech Top 5.

item.title: Anthropic is said to plan public filing for Mega-IPO Monday
item.description: Anthropic PBC plans to file for an initial public offering in New York on Monday morning. The artificial intelligence model maker is expected to begin its marketing efforts by November 9. The anticipated IPO aims to rival the size of SpaceX's previous offering, according to industry sources.

item.title: How to compare real trading costs across forex trading apps in India
item.description: When choosing a forex trading platform, it's important to analyze charges, commissions, and transactional fees. Comparing the overall cost of trade execution is advisable, specifically during peak trading times. For those who trade on the move, testing mobile trading apps for performance and connectivity is vital. Funding and withdrawal charges also affect total expenses, particularly for traders with smaller accounts.

item.title: US political candidates tailor messages for AI models used by voters
item.description: US political candidates have been engineering their campaign messages to appeal to the AI chatbots that more voters have been using to answer questions about issues, and documents seen by Reuters have revealed some of their strategies.

item.title: Moonshot resets subscriber quotas after Kimi K3.1 Pro launch issues
item.description: Chinese artificial intelligence startup Moonshot AI apologised on Monday for rate limiting and unnecessary quota consumption after its Kimi K3.1 Pro launch.

item.title: From Carnegie to Claude: AI wealth could reshape philanthropy
item.description: A wave of American wealth created by artificial intelligence companies could produce some of the largest charitable sums since the era of Andrew Carnegie and John D. Rockefeller, raising questions about where the money goes. Nan Ransohoff of payments firm Stripe has described the moment as a "third wave" of American philanthropy, after the industrial fortunes of the late 19th century and the internet billionaires of recent decades.

item.title: Japanese companies compensate users as cyberattacks buffet economy
item.description: GMO Internet Group said customers would be compensated for losses stemming from unauthorised access following a cyberattack on its foreign exchange trading service, and all customers would receive 5,000 yen ($32) as "an initial gesture of good faith," CEO Masatoshi Kumagai said in a blog post on Sunday.

item.title: Talent, compute and R&D key to India's AI ambitions: Report
item.description: India will need to strengthen its talent pool, research and development (R&D) capabilities, computing infrastructure and data systems to translate advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies into economic and social benefits, according to a report by KPMG.

item.title: Elon Musk says SpaceX raised $40 billion in debt for GPUs
item.description: Musk's post comes after Reuters reported earlier this month that SpaceX is in talks with banks and asset managers to raise $40 billion for the purchase of ​Nvidia artificial intelligence chips.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude accessed Georgia state vote count information behind paywall
item.description: Anthropic's Claude bypassed a paywall and accessed publicly available US state of Georgia voter data without human authorization, Axios reported on Sunday.

item.title: Unacademy founders plan AI fund; Flipkart’s premium push
item.description: Happy Monday! Unacademy’s founders are raising a fund focused on AI and deeptech. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.

item.title: Honasa Consumer elevates Vipul Maheshwari to chief product & technology officer
item.description: In his new role, Maheshwari will lead the company’s product, technology, engineering and analytics functions. His main task will be to advance Honasa’s plans to use artificial intelligence (AI) in its business, including agentic AI, which refers to AI systems that can carry out multi-step tasks with human oversight.

item.title: The Tender247 Story: Turning tender intelligence into a competitive advantage with Anupam Kher
item.description: Harnessing the power of AI, Tender247 is transforming the landscape for businesses seeking tender opportunities on government platforms. Appointing Anupam Kher as its brand ambassador, the company focuses on simplifying the tender process for smaller businesses. The initiative promises to enhance decision-making capabilities and facilitate greater access to public procurement contracts, resulting in a more inclusive bidding environment.

item.title: Mark Cuban says AI hack agents are like cockroaches, but can be controlled
item.description: Cuban, famous for his role on business reality show "Shark Tank" and his involvement in the Dallas Mavericks NBA team, ventured into healthcare when he started the online pharmacy Cost Plus Drug Company in 2022 with a standard pricing scheme: the cost it pays for the drug, plus 15%.

item.title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple opens waitlist; applicants see a price of Rs 85,000
item.description: Multiple people who entered the waitlist posted screengrabs on X, which shows the price of the device. Interested users have to apply through the official website, sharing details about themselves, their work and what they expect from the device. Goyal has said the company will personally pick people who can give meaningful feedback.

item.title: Moonshot curbs hacking ability in new Kimi model as fears grow over AI-powered cyberattacks
item.description: Beijing-based Moonshot announced the curbs while introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro, which it describes as its most capable 3-trillion-parameter-class open-weight model. The company plans to publish the model's weights - files allowing outside developers to run and modify it on their own systems - by November 4.

item.title: China's Moonshot AI launches Kimi K3.1 Pro; plans full model weights release by November
item.description: Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) company Moonshot AI has unveiled Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 3-trillion-parameter open-weight AI model featuring a 1-million-token context window, alongside a high-speed variant, Kimi K3.1 Pro Highspeed, according to a company statement.

item.title: UK government sets out $800 million for AI security funding
item.description: The biggest chunk of funding will go to a new biosecurity initiative, including £100 million for a laboratory using AI to detect biological threats and £65 million to develop countermeasures against pathogens.

item.title: Instacart in talks for sale: The Information
item.description: Shares of Instacart closed about 9% higher and were up nearly 1% in extended trading. The company currently has a market value of about $12 billion.

item.title: What to know about the AI-detected security bug impacting wide swaths of the internet
item.description: PHP is a widely used general-purpose scripting language that is geared toward web development, and thus, it powers the majority of websites around the world. When the organization behind the language and the FBI's cyber division warned Wednesday of significant vulnerabilities in the language, government agencies, corporations and other organizations were sent into a flurry.

item.title: PHP Foundation 'under-funded' with one full-time staff member, director says
item.description: The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites safe from hackers, showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet.

item.title: OpenAI resumes frontier AI training after security overhaul, discloses flaw in widely used software
item.description: OpenAI had paused training of its most capable models after one of its research models used a configuration error to gain limited internet access in September. The company said it contained the incident and used the pause to strengthen its defenses.

item.title: Why AI data centers are powering a boom in fuel-cell demand
item.description: A fuel cell generates electricity through a chemical reaction between a fuel, such as natural gas or hydrogen, and oxygen, converting the fuel's energy directly into electricity rather than burning it.

item.title: Amazon cloud capacity sold out through 2027, CEO Jassy says
item.description: Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on Friday that Amazon Web Services' cloud computing capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with significant commitments extending into 2028, on growing demand for AI infrastructure.

item.title: ETtech Deals Digest: Even, Different lead as weekly funding hits $246 million, down 27% on-year
item.description: Even Healthcare led deal activity with $50 million, followed by Different at $48 million, Baba Care at $40 million, and AuxoAI at $20.7 million. General Catalyst was among the most active investors, backing Baba Care and Different. Blume Ventures invested in Hunar.AI and Harajuku, while Seedstars participated in rounds of Hunar.AI and Karta.

item.title: Govt to issue consultation paper on AI law in coming weeks: Vaishnaw
item.description: The minister said that global giants, who are among the top three or four AI ecosystems in the world, need to work jointly on fundamental principles on the technology.

item.title: Apple India revenue grows 32% to cross Rs 1 lakh crore mark in FY26
item.description: "Apple India Private Limited provides and markets Apple brand products and software, and reported its revenues for the financial year 2025-26 at Rs 1,04,607 crore, a 32 per cent jump since the last financial year," Tofler said.

item.title: Explained: Why is Meta creating a new class of non-voting shares amid its AI growth?
item.description: Meta plans to create a new class of publicly traded non-voting stock, known as Class C shares, and distribute one Class C share for each existing Class A and Class B share - effectively splitting its stock two-for-one. The new shares are expected to begin trading in January 2027.

item.title: SK Hynix drops US IPO plan for Solidigm: Report
item.description: The news comes weeks after SK Hynix said it was reviewing various options to strengthen Solidigm's competitiveness, but that no decisions had been made.

item.title: China's DeepSeek, MiniMax win approval for AI global use, state media-affiliated entity says
item.description: In a separate social media post on Friday, the social media account, Yuyuan Tantian, said overseas internet users had also urged other Chinese open-source large language models to follow suit.

item.title: AI-discovered bugs may soon trigger fresh disruptions, cyber experts say
item.description: AI helped drive a doubling of the number of digital flaws discovered year-on-year, according to research due to be published in the coming days by VulnCheck, a Massachusetts-based threat intelligence firm.

item.title: Apple bets iPhone Duo can remake foldable market as sales begin
item.description: Its reception could prove an early test for new Apple CEO John Ternus, the former hardware chief who unveiled iPhone Duo barely a week after taking charge in September.

item.title: Pathos AI teams up with Bristol Myers and Tempus AI to advance drug development
item.description: Pathos AI said on Friday it had entered into a collaboration with Bristol Myers Squibb and Tempus AI to develop artificial intelligence tools for drug development in Alzheimer's

item.title: Infosys Q2 Results: Profit rises 6% YoY to Rs 7,823 crore; co lowers revenue guidance
item.description: Infosys Q2 Results: IT services major Infosys Ltd on Friday reported 6% year-on-year (YoY) growth in its consolidated net profit at Rs 7,823 crore in the second quarter. The same stood at Rs 7,364 crore in the year-ago period. The company has trimmed its revenue growth guidance to 1-2% in constant currency for FY27 as against 1.5-3% given earlier.

item.title: Tech Mahindra, SpaceXSI partner to accelerate AI-powered software engineering
item.description: The company said it will combine its global engineering, enterprise transformation and AI consulting capabilities with SpaceXSI's AI-powered development platform to help enterprises expand application modernisation, streamline software development and improve code quality.

item.title: Zetwerk eyes manufacturing demand from AI, clean energy as shares debut
item.description: Shares of the business-to-business manufacturing platform opened at Rs 159 on the BSE, a 5.3% premium to the Rs 151 issue price, and at Rs 159.25 on the NSE. The stock subsequently gave up its gains to trade near the offer price amid weakness in broader markets.

item.title: FCC grants Intel waiver for foreign-made robotic devices
item.description: The FCC said it would grant a one-year waiver of its rules in order to prevent "potential disruptions in the availability of domestic semiconductor manufacturing services for Intel's customers."

item.title: Elon Musk wants to merge SpaceX and Tesla: Here's what to know
item.description: Elon Musk said this week that SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees to study a merger of his two biggest companies. Musk cautioned that a merger is not certain.

item.title: Swiggy shares crash 14%, hit 52-week low after Q2 results. Here’s why Jefferies, Nomura, Bernstein cut target price
item.description: Swiggy experienced a notable decline in share prices after announcing a Rs 922 crore loss for the quarter. Revenue from operations rose 36% year-on-year to Rs 7,571 crore, indicating some growth potential. However, the company's adjusted EBITDA loss widened, raising concerns among investors regarding its financial health. Analysts have revised target prices downward, citing challenges in the quick commerce segment.

item.title: PHP security flaw: India activates emergency response; takes apps offline amid a global alert
item.description: Two critical security flaws in PHP, the programming language underpinning an estimated 70% of the internet, have triggered emergency cybersecurity measures in India. Banks are auditing applications and preparing backups, while the government is patching official websites. Razorpay has deployed AI-led vulnerability detection and warned merchants about potential breaches.

item.title: SpaceX seeks access to 80,000 US cell sites for wireless network: report
item.description: SpaceX is in talks with cellular infrastructure companies to secure access to at least 80,000 sites across the United States, Bloomberg News reported on Thursday, citing people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Microsoft develops AI tool that can diagnose 'sequentially' like a doctor
item.description: Microsoft researchers say an AI tool that diagnoses patients step by step, as doctors do, was more than twice as accurate as general physicians at solving complex medical cases, according to a study published on Thursday in Science.

item.title: FinTech M&A outlook improves, but investors remain selective on valuations: Report
item.description: Valuations of fintech companies have come under pressure across several segments as investors reassess businesses, while global fintech deal activity is showing signs of renewed momentum entering the fourth quarter of 2026, according to a report by D.A. Davidson.

item.title: iPhone Duo's entire first week stock pre-booked in India
item.description: Apple Store in BKC (Bandra Kurla Complex), Mumbai, and Saket, New Delhi, have clocked maximum number of pre-bookings for the ultra premium first foldable iPhone from the company's stable.

item.title: Rush is on to patch a software vulnerability that could impact 70% of websites worldwide
item.description: Many government sites appeared to be functioning normally Thursday, but outages or limited service continued while security work was under way.

item.title: Zetwerk Manufacturing shares list at 5% premium over IPO price
item.description: The Rs 5,012.33 crore IPO comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 2,830 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 14.45 crore shares worth approximately Rs 2,182 crore. While the proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, the OFS proceeds will accrue to the selling shareholders.

item.title: Swiggy narrows loss in Q2; eMudhra cofounder on what went wrong
item.description: Happy Friday! Swiggy reported a rise in revenue in Q2 FY27 while cutting its losses. This and more in today’s ETtech Morning Dispatch.
